label: service.bund.de — Ausschreibungen
terms_note: German federal portal; public RSS; bids on the buyer's e-Vergabe platform.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (search-result RSS). Lane `assist` → **keep**; RSS for discovery. Confidence high.
reference.limits: - Public; bids on buyer platforms. - German federal portal; public RSS; bids on the buyer's e-Vergabe platform.

adapter.terms: service.bund.de (Bundesverwaltungsamt) public tender search. Bids are submitted on the contracting authority's e-Vergabe platform.

search_postings.note: The RSS view (jobsrss=true) of the tender search form, newest first, 100 results; `query` is the form's search field (templateQueryString, full text). category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent — ignore next_page. description is HTML with Erfüllungsort, Vergabestelle (buyer), Angebotsfrist (deadline) and Veröffentlichungsende; url carries a '#track=feed-callforbids' fragment.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: Notice pages (/IMPORTE/Ausschreibungen/…html) are HTML only; there is no per-notice machine-readable endpoint.
not_offered.submit_bid: Bids are submitted on the contracting authority's e-Vergabe platform linked from the notice; service.bund.de has no submission API.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
